parameters.help_en: The HTTP or HTTPS URL of the national emblem side of the ID card
parameters.help_zh: 身份证国徽面图片的HTTP或HTTPS链接
parameters.name: id_card_back_image_url

parameters.help_en: The HTTP or HTTPS URL of the front-facing facial photo
parameters.help_zh: 人像正面照图片的HTTP或HTTPS链接
parameters.name: face_image_url

parameters.help_en: The business scenario identifier for the ID Verification service. Create one in the console first. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/127885.html
parameters.help_zh: 使用实人认证服务的业务场景标识。请先参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/127885.html在控制台完成创建
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID that identifies a verification task. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. For a single verification task, the system supports unlimited submissions until the verification is passed and the task is completed.

> Use a different BizId for each new verification task
parameters.help_zh:
标识一次认证任务的唯一ID，不超过64字符。针对一次认证任务，系统支持无限次发起提交，直到最终认证通过，该任务完结。

> 发起不同的认证任务时需要更换不同的BizId
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en: The HTTP or HTTPS URL of the portrait side of the ID card
parameters.help_zh: 身份证人像面图片的HTTP或HTTPS链接
parameters.name: id_card_front_image_url

parameters.help_en: The ID of the end user, such as the account ID of the end user
parameters.help_zh: 终端用户的ID，例如终端用户的账号ID
parameters.name: user_id
